channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio reitera que votará pelo fim da 6x1 e diz que maioria do PL deve seguir a opinião dele
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro reiterated his support for the PEC that eliminates the 6x1 work schedule, stating that the majority of the PL should follow his position. He has not yet spoken with the party but believes the bench will follow his stance.

item.title: Casado: MDB é mais uma peça no tabuleiro de apoios do centrão a Flávio
item.description: MDB's support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff reflects the centrão alliance strategy, according to Letícia Casado. The columnist noted that the pursuit of political influence attracts fragmented endorsements, illustrating the strategic behavior of regional parties.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: 'Não vou no debate da Band domingo'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he will not participate in the Band debate on Sunday, 18. He mentioned that attendance at the final second-round debate against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) is still being evaluated by the campaign.

item.title: Mesmo com Marçal na campanha, PRTB nega apoio e acusa Flávio de 'enganar conservadores'
item.description: The PRTB denies support for Flávio Marçal and accuses him of deceiving conservative sectors, even with his involvement in the campaign. Leonardo Avalanche confirms the party will not support any presidential candidate.

item.title: Última pesquisa presidente segundo turno: veja números atualizados de Lula e Flávio
item.description: Polls measure the 2026 second round between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with margins of error of 2 points and 1.8 percentage points, respectively. The data reflect the electoral race but do not indicate specific preferences.

item.title: Nunes defende redução da maioridade penal em ato do MDB com Flávio
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) reaffirmed the party's support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the runoff, advocating for lowering the age of criminal responsibility during an event in São Paulo. Nunes emphasized public security and criticized the competition for not prioritizing the fight against crime.

item.title: Lula promete criação do Pé-de-Meia para universitários em 2027
item.description: Lula announced the creation of the 'Pé-de-Meia' for university students in a potential fourth term starting in 2027, with an estimated cost of R$ 4.6 billion funded by the oil social fund. The initiative is expected to benefit around one million young people annually, expanding support for public higher education.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE analisa ação sobre gastos com publicidade de Lula
item.description: The TSE opened an extraordinary virtual session to judge cases involving PT and PL, including a accusation by PL against Lula and the Secom minister for excessive institutional advertising expenses. Minister André Mendonça ordered the submission of detailed expense information between 2023 and 2026, highlighting discrepancies in the data.

item.title: Nunes Marques alerta campanhas para alta de 200% na judicialização eleitoral
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques warned campaigns about a 217% increase in election-related lawsuits after the first round of 2026, highlighting risks to democracy and political debate. A meeting with representatives from Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro discussed disinformation, deepfakes, and server protection. The TSE provided image and voice protection tools to candidates.

item.title: Ibovespa desvaloriza mais de 1% com realização de lucros e incerteza eleitoral
item.description: The Ibovespa fell 1.04% to 206,800 points, driven by profit-taking and election uncertainty tied to Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). External tensions (US-Iran) and the Boletim Focus forecasts, which lower Selic expectations and raise inflation for 2026, also influenced the market.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: O escândalo das Refugiadas de Vorcaro e o impasse dos MEIs com Lula
item.description: The Antagonist Chat discusses Lula's announced debt forgiveness for microentrepreneurs and the scandal involving Daniel Vorcaro in funding a network of female modeling for private events. The former Banco Master controller is under investigation for allegedly organizing a prostitution network with involvement of public figures.

item.title: Lula leva segurança e 6x1 à TV na véspera de votações no Senado
item.description: Lula releases campaign ad supporting public security and ending the 6x1 work schedule ahead of Senate votes, pressuring opponents for support and promoting anti-organized crime proposals.

item.title: Erika Hilton promete acionar TSE contra “Tropa do Flávio”
item.description: Erika Hilton (PSOL-SP) promised to file a lawsuit with the TSE to block the 'Tropa do Flávio' WhatsApp channel, citing similar irregularities to those of the 'Exército do Lula'. The TSE president's decision was later reconsidered.

item.title: Janones pede ao TSE liberação imediata do canal "Exército do Lula"
item.description: Federal Deputy André Janones requested immediate release of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, criticizing the 48-hour wait imposed by Nunes Marques. His defense argues the channel is a supporter platform, not an official campaign structure, advocating for fines instead of blocking. Corregator Villas Bôas had authorized provisional operation of the channel.

item.title: Globo tira Quem Ama Cuida do ar por causa de debate presidencial
item.description: Globo has decided to pull the telenovela 'Quem Ama Cuida' off the air on the night of October 23 to broadcast the presidential debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for the second round of elections. One episode of the telenovela will be canceled to accommodate the live broadcast following the news.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula enrola os MEIs
item.description: President Lula announced a constitutional amendment bill to forgive debts of individual micro-entrepreneurs (MEIs), but Congress has no deadline for approval, potentially causing electoral delays. Critics frame the move as an electioneering tactic with limited legal feasibility.

item.title: Governo Lula diz que perdão de R$ 12,6 bi não pesa no Orçamento
item.description: The Lula government announced a R$ 12.6 billion debt forgiveness for individual micro-entrepreneurs (MEIs), claiming it will not have a fiscal impact in 2026, as most debts are deemed unrecoverable. The measure, pending congressional approval, aims to benefit 3.6 million micro-entrepreneurs and is part of a small business support package.

item.title: Veja cronologia da guerra de decisões sobre o canal 'Exército do Lula'
item.description: The WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', created by Congressman André Janones, was censored for the second time by TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques. President Lula's campaign officially registered the channel with TSE after the censorship. The group faced legal action over alleged irregularities in distributing electoral content.

item.title: PEC do fim da escala 6×1 caminha para aprovação no Senado com apoio até de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PEC to end the 6×1 workday advances in the Senate with support from figures like Flávio Bolsonaro, who shifted his stance due to electoral pressure. The measure, a priority in Lula's campaign, is expected to pass with 49 votes as the opposition avoids direct confrontation.

item.title: Mensagens apagadas no “Exército do Lula” eram “missões”, diz Janones
item.description: André Janones denied spreading fake news on the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, claiming deleted messages were 'missions' fulfilled by Lula supporters. He stated he will not publish fake news and that content removal was done in good faith, without a court order.

item.title: Nunes Marques diz que ‘Exército do Lula’ pode voltar a funcionar em 48 horas
item.description: TSE minister Nunes Marques authorized the resumption of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, requiring it to be registered as electoral advertising and wait 48 hours after registration. The removal and reinstatement of the channel sparked internal conflict within the TSE, with differing assessments regarding the spread of fake news.

item.title: “Temos vivido como se fôssemos servir outras nações”, diz Cármen Lúcia
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia criticized Brazil's submissive posture toward other nations, highlighting the country's natural and cultural potential. She advocated for institutional trust, gender equity, and development focused on present-day achievements.

item.title: TSE manda campanha de Lula retirar anúncio que associa Flávio ao crime organizado
item.description: The TSE ordered Lula's campaign to remove an advertisement linking Flávio Bolsonaro to organized crime through the Public Security PEC. The decision was issued by Minister Estela Aranha, with a 24-hour deadline for removal. The PT campaign used the content on social media as part of its electoral strategy.

item.title: Por que Flávio Bolsonaro voltou atrás sobre o fim da escala 6x1?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro announced his support for ending the 6x1 shift schedule, reversing his previous stance in which he criticized the proposal as opportunistic. He justified the shift by saying most Brazilian workers want to flexibilize their work hours, suggesting a 'flexible schedule' agreed upon by employer and employee.

item.title: Após polêmica com 'Exército do Lula', equipe do PL informa canal de WhatsApp 'Tropa do Flávio' ao TSE, que não estava registrado
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign (PL) informed the TSE about the WhatsApp channel 'Tropa do Flávio' following controversies involving the 'Exército do Lula', which was also registered. Both digital mobilization tools are questioned for potential electoral law violations.

item.title: Eduardo Paes no 2º turno? Sim, mas na campanha de Lula
item.description: Eduardo Paes joins Lula's campaign coordination in Rio de Janeiro for the 2026 runoff. His involvement aims to strengthen centrist support in the state, aligning local leaders with the PT strategy. The article highlights the role of regional figures in the electoral planning.

item.title: As 3 falhas na campanha à reeleição de Lula segundo o presidente do PT
item.description: Edinho Silva, president of the PT, acknowledged flaws in Lula's re-election campaign during the first round, citing difficulties in material production, inter-state coordination, and lack of dialogue with allies from 2022. He emphasized the need to reconnect with sectors that supported Lula in the previous election and stated that the issues were resolved in the second round. Edinho confirmed that Lula will participate in direct debates against Flávio Dutra.

item.title: Nunes Marques libera canal de WhatsApp “Exército do Lula”
item.description: The President of the Brazilian Electoral Court, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, authorized the resumption of the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', created by Congressman André Janones to support Lula's campaign. Following a legal dispute with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who alleged fake news dissemination, the minister set conditions for the channel's operation, including notification of the address to the Electoral Justice and clear identification of electoral advertising. The channel, with 4.2 million followers, remains active under TSE supervision.

item.title: Líder do PT defende votação de aumento do faturamento do MEI nesta semana
item.description: PT leader deputy Pedro Uczai advocated for voting this week on a project that increases the MEI revenue limit, which is expected to rise from R$ 81,000 to R$ 140,000 in 2028.

item.title: Quem está na frente nas pesquisas para presidente, Lula ou Flávio? Veja últimos levantamentos
item.description: The BTG/Nexus and PoderData/AYA polls released on April 13, 2026, measure the presidential runoff between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with margins of error of two points and 1.8 percentage points, respectively. The surveys show no clear frontrunner, keeping the race balanced.

item.title: Mulheres rejeitam mais a extrema direita e podem decidir o 2° turno no Brasil, diz pesquisador
item.description: After a first round favoring Flávio Bolsonaro over Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, political scientist Josué Medeiros notes the Brazilian far-right's consolidation phase, with women showing stronger rejection of this bloc and potentially swaying the runoff outcome.

item.title: Tatiana Farah: Ação de Kassio pode ser 'tiro no pé'; canal cresce pós-veto
item.description: Tatiana Farah assessed that Kassio Nunes Marques' decision to block the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel may strengthen Lula's social media mobilization. The analysis was presented on UOL News, highlighting the impact of this decision on the electoral scenario.

item.title: Em anúncio de pacote para MEIs, Lula diz que economia está "longe do ideal"
item.description: Lula announced a support package for individual entrepreneurs (MEIs), acknowledging the economy is still far from ideal, with GDP growth of 2.3%. Measures include debt forgiveness of R$12.6 billion, increased revenue limits, and Pix grants. The announcement comes 12 days before the second round of elections.

item.title: Lula anuncia Pix MEI, que prevê repasse de R$ 5 mil para microempreendedor
item.description: Lula announced the Pix MEI program, offering transfers of up to R$ 5,000 to micro-entrepreneurs, with R$ 5 billion allocated from 2027 to 2030. The initiative is part of the Prospera MEI package aimed at supporting the popular economy and renegotiating small business debts.

item.title: Nunes Marques ignora corregedor eleitoral, suspende canal de Lula e impõe condições para funcionar
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, suspended the decision of the electoral clerk Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva and maintained the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' channel on WhatsApp, imposing conditions for its reactivation, such as communicating the channel address to the Electoral Justice. The measure was adopted after Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign filed a lawsuit for spreading fake news through the channel, which mobilizes over 4.2 million users. The AEED reported no false information posts on the channel but expressed concern about mass message dissemination before the second round.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: o que muda na conta de luz, nos combustíveis e na Petrobras
item.description: Lula and Flávio propose different strategies to reduce energy costs in Brazil. Lula advocates expanding state-owned enterprises and consumer protection policies, while Flávio suggests reducing subsidies and taxes, promoting private investments. Their proposals may impact electricity, fuel, and natural gas prices.

item.title: Após impasse judicial, campanha registra canal de WhatsApp 'Exército do Lula' no TSE
item.description: Lula's campaign officially registered the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel with the TSE after legal disputes. The tool faced controversies over alleged misinformation, according to Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign. With registration completed, Lula's team is now officially responsible for the channel's content.

item.title: Dados da Presidência confirmam reuniões de Vorcaro no Planalto com operador de esquema no governo Lula
item.description: Presidency data confirms banker Daniel Vorcaro attended at least two meetings at Planalto Palace accompanied by operator Júlio Cezar, linked to Minister Alexandre Padilha, in an alleged scheme of kickbacks to release funds from pension schemes during Lula's government. According to Vorcaro, the group planned to capture up to R$10 billion from Previ, Petros, and Postalis coffers, in exchange for R$1 billion in bribe payments, including a R$500,000 signal paid after formal authorization of Banco Master to operate in the funds. The plea bargain proposal was rejected by the Federal Police and the Attorney General's Office due to lack of political pressure.

item.title: Em pacote para MEIs, Lula anuncia perdão de dívida tributária, ‘Pix’ de R$ 5 mil e novo Desenrola
item.description: Twelve days before the runoff, Lula unveiled the Prospera MEI package, offering tax debt forgiveness, a R$5,000 Pix, and debt renegotiation for microentrepreneurs. These measures aim to attract voters during the 2026 electoral campaign.

item.title: Cueva leu 21 laudas e escreveu outras 13 em 4 minutos a favor de Lula
item.description: The Electoral General Counsel, Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, reviewed and signed a 13-page decision favoring President Lula in under 4 minutes, reversing the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' channel ordered by TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques. Nunes Marques criticized Cueva for not awaiting the collegial opinion of the TSE, questioning the judge's prudence.

item.title: Saiba as medidas anunciadas pelo governo para microempreendedores
item.description: The federal government announced the Prospera MEI package, which includes debt forgiveness of R$12.6 billion for 3.6 million MEIs, bank renegotiation with 90% discounts, a Pix MEI funding line of R$5 billion, and an increase in the MEI revenue limit. The measures aim to reduce debt and stimulate the economy of microentrepreneurs, with some proposals requiring approval by the National Congress.

item.title: Lula entra na disputa com o bolsonarismo pela bandeira da 'prosperidade'
item.description: Lula announced a package of measures for individual micro-entrepreneurs at the Planalto Palace as a strategy to compete with the Bolsonarismo on the prosperity agenda and reverse the disadvantage against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro visita a su padre en prisión domiciliaria tras un veto de tres meses
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro visited his father, Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest after three months apart. The meeting takes place during the campaign for the 2026 presidential runoff election. Polls show a technical tie between Flávio and Lula.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lamenta morte de Netinho: "Um dos grandes nomes do axé"
item.description: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) mourned the death of singer Netinho, calling him one of the great names of axé music. Netinho died from complications of non-Hodgkin lymphoma and had previously called for military intervention after the 2022 elections.

item.title: “Marcou gerações”: Flávio Bolsonaro lamenta morte de Netinho nas redes sociais
item.description: The singer Netinho, 60, died from non-Hodgkin's lymphoma. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) mourned the artist's death on social media, highlighting his contribution to axé music and political activism supporting Jair Bolsonaro. Netinho, a staunch Bolsonaro ally, participated in 2022 and 2023 protests, including events related to January 8th.

item.title: A avaliação ‘poliana’ de campanha de Lula após revés no primeiro turno
item.description: After Flávio Bolsonaro led the first round, Lula's campaign seeks to turn the unexpected result into mobilization, highlighting greater digital organization and street presence. Allies believe the setback may drive a positive reaction in the second round.

item.title: “Pressão da sociedade”, diz Lula após Flávio apoiar fim da escala 6 x 1
item.description: President Lula emphasized that the 6 x 1 escalator must end due to social pressure, thanking the PL for aligning with the government. Flávio Bolsonaro reversed his stance and supported the PEC, citing majority worker support but criticizing regulatory gaps in the proposal.

item.title: Flávio ironiza campanha de Lula: "Vão dizer que vou acabar com o Sol"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro mocked Lula's campaign, claiming fake news about him is spreading lies, such as ending aliens' rights. The statement comes amid legal proceedings at the TSE between the campaigns.

item.title: Meta nega operar para favorecer ou prejudicar candidatos nas eleições
item.description: Meta Group denied to the TSE that it operated its systems to favor or harm candidates in the 2026 elections, claiming that restrictions on Lula's content were global technical failures. The PT campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE after denouncing disproportionate impact from these issues. The company emphasized it has no responsibility over algorithms and rejected favoritism accusations.

item.title: Um surpreendente ‘cabo eleitoral’ para Flávio Bolsonaro na disputa contra Lula
item.description: Robson Bonin accused the Supreme Federal Court of acting as a 'campaign marshal' for Flávio Bolsonaro by allowing the resumption of family visits to former President Jair Bolsonaro, benefiting his campaign against Lula. The decision by Minister Alexandre de Moraes raised criticisms for allegedly favoring bolsonarismo, reinforcing the narrative of political persecution against the Bolsonaro family.
